rows.grounds: compound sva+artha in accusative sense indicating purpose; internal sandhi preserved in fused token
particle used with vā to mark an alternative
compound para+artha in accusative sense indicating purpose; internal sandhi preserved in fused token
compound apa+mṛtyu denoting premature death; nominative subject
verb expressing the removal or perishing of untimely death

items.question: For whose benefit can untimely death be destroyed by this means?
premises: The action may be undertaken for one's own purpose.
The action may be undertaken for another's purpose.
Untimely death is destroyed in either case.
items.inference: Untimely death perishes whether the intended benefit is for oneself or for another.
uncertainties: The precise force of atha alongside vā is contextually inferred as an alternative marker.
items.plain_english: Whether for one's own sake or for another's sake, untimely death is destroyed.
